## 

## Presentation

This presentation will be discussing how to integrate Uncrewed Aerial Systems (UAS) with GIS workflows. It highlights applications used by the United States Army Corps of Engineers, including high-resolution orthomosaic and 3D mesh generation, infrastructure inspection, long-term monitoring and geospatial data collection. The presentation will also cover how UAS-derived datasets can be incorporated into GIS for improved spatial analysis, data accuracy, and more efficient project planning and decision support.
